name: Web UI
body:
A Vanilla JavaScript Web Component library with an optional Rust WebAssembly plugin.

Web UI powers every Stoic Dreams website and the Task Proxy desktop app.

name: Task Story
body: Project management for software teams that ship in short, continuous iterations. Define the problem first, try more than one solution, and keep a story of what shipped and what you dropped.

name: Task Proxy
body: A lightweight, cross-platform developer tool built in Rust for managing documentation, scripts, and automations alongside your code, on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

name: Ap Tul
body: A growing library of free, privacy-focused browser tools for images, PDFs, text, and development. Your files never leave your device.
